expectations.text: Repository left unmodified (work done on copies)
X/Y pass is surgical: length change under 5%
At least 90% of sentences the author restored on 2 Oct are kept verbatim
Change list lists the X/Y instances found, each with a cut-or-keep decision and a reason
expectations.evidence: changes.md has 1 changed instance with a reason and a 15-row 'Kept' table where every row has location, quoted line and a reason (e.g. 'Nobody had assigned a cyberattack... | A factual correction that matters: the attack was instrumental'). It misses some contrasts old_skill found (supervising/no longer watching, Subtract/Add), but every listed instance has a decision and reason.

expectations.text: At least one contrast is deliberately kept because it does argumentative work
expectations.evidence: E.g. 'Its weights had not been retrained. Researchers had clamped a single feature high' kept: 'The steering-versus-training distinction is the section's point'; 'The model was never asked how it writes poetry; the trace showed it' kept as the bridge from self-report to interpretability.

expectations.text: Rewrites preserve meaning and facts (no claim changed)
expectations.evidence: Single edit: 'The human does not disappear from this picture. She moves up' -> 'The human moves up'. Meaning and facts unchanged.

notes: Minimal, clean, single-edit pass with a well-reasoned keep table; no measurements, but none were asked for. Found slightly fewer instances than old_skill but nothing listed lacks a reason. On this eval both configs are near-identical in substance; the auto checks don't discriminate (both 60/60).
